evidence_basis: P1 v0.6.6 six-task-type qualification failure spectrum

changes.rule: Remove model-authored answer_status. A non-null answer with at least one valid evidence handle is framework-supported; a null answer with zero handles is framework-absent. Mixed states fail schema validation.
Use conditional JSON Schema so absent requires answer=null, normalized_value=null, and evidence_handles=[]; no literal status string is accepted as an answer.

Replace free-form conflict classification with grounded source_claims. Each claim must contain source_id, evidence_handle, and normalized claim value. The framework derives contradictory_sources only when at least two grounded source claims have distinct normalized values.

A first-attempt model timeout remains a recorded model failure. No invisible retry, output repair, or fallback substitution is allowed in qualification scoring. A separately identified fallback arm may be evaluated only as a new archived run.

unchanged: Frozen tasks, documents, target pages, interventions, model digest, MinerU artifacts, evidence handles, and hidden simulated references.
v0.6.6 registry-driven multi-page loading and integrity checks.
prohibited: No reference answer in inference requests.
No posthoc semantic repair or model-output rewriting.
No P2 access before v0.7 implementation freeze and P1 requalification.
